scope: Exact selected text payload, source-byte binding and necessary public content only.

screening.method: UTF-8 text and recursive JSON string-field scan for credential prefixes, private-key material, JWTs, signed download links, bearer values, URL credentials and email addresses, followed by contextual interpretation of selected fixture/closed fields. Matched values are never printed.

semanticBoundaries: CLI GHA-shaped local runId 0 and its generated github-actions-main buildKind are offline fixtures, not production release authority.
The separately supported local-drill seal is a minimal artifact regression, not package/provider/registry acceptance.
Original failed production log has no changed-file list; two-mode attribution uses deterministic same-tree reproduction, not unseen CI filesystem data.
The root-notified actual PR head/parent/tree/file-list binding is attributed to root; this archive step performs no network verification.
Prepared ops commit and dispatch request are unpublished and undispatched at the retained record; the M1 payload must be rebound before any later use.
E2B candidate/build-cleanup success is not final public runtime, subscription or release-cleanup success.
Pending PR CI/E2B await-web status comes from the owner notice, not a new live status read.
excludedContent: private complete job logs and API envelopes
originalMaterialPolicy: Excluded originals remain unmodified locally; only previously recorded identifiers/hashes are referenced. No original is silently redacted.
publicSafeSelections: local fixture commands and source/commit metadata
explicit unexecuted request and initial merge record
